samples.xml_description:
<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>A series-parallel conversion circuit.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LOADING">Loading state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DONE">Done state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" type="integer">Counter to keep track of the number of serial input data bits received.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_parallel" type="integer">Parallel output data register.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_valid" type="integer">Valid signal for the output data.</reg>
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 0;
                dout_parallel <= 0;
                dout_valid <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (cnt)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (din_valid == 1) begin
                            cnt <= 1;
                            dout_parallel[7-cnt] <= din_serial;
                        end
                    end
                    LOADING: begin
                        if (din_valid == 1) begin
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                            dout_parallel[7-cnt] <= din_serial;
                        end
                    end
                    DONE: begin
                        cnt <= 0;
                        dout_valid <= 1;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Counts the number of serial input data bits received and stores them in dout_parallel in reverse order. Sets dout_valid to 1 when all 8 serial data bits have been received, otherwise sets it to 0.</implementation>
</module>
